<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Do You Want a Mint?|id=A0116}}</noinclude>
{{SbcNewline2}}{{SbcNewline2}}{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
The topic of this lesson is irregular breath and how to deal with it. Our keyword is also irregular: '''huele''' – it smells from the irregular verb '''oler''' – to smell. 
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0016|A0016: I feel sick]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0052|A0052: Smells good]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0096|A0096: I am allergic]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Quieres una menta?'''
| Do you want a mint?
| '''¿Por qué? ¿Me huele la boca?'''
| Why? Does my mouth stink?
| '''Sí, ¡toma!'''
| Yes, take this!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿Quieres una menta?'''
| Do you want a mint?
| '''¿Por qué? ¿Me huele la boca?'''
| Why? Does my mouth stink?
| '''Sí, ¡toma!'''
| Yes, take this!
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Do you want a mint?
| '''¿Quieres una menta?'''
| Why? Does my mouth stink?
| '''¿Por qué? ¿Me huele la boca?'''
| Yes, take this!
| '''Sí, ¡toma!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Do you want a mint?
| '''¿Quieres una menta?'''
| Why? Does my mouth stink?
| '''¿Por qué? ¿Me huele la boca?'''
| Yes, take this!
| '''Sí, ¡toma!'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Take a mint! Do you want to?
| '''¡Toma una menta! ¿Quieres?'''
| Why? 
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| For ({{=}} '''por''') the mouth.
| '''Por la boca.'''
| Does my breath smell?
| '''¿Me huele la boca?'''
| Yes, take it!
| '''Sí, ¡toma!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Take a mint! Do you want to?
| '''¡Toma una menta! ¿Quieres?'''
| Why? 
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| For ({{=}} '''por''') the mouth.
| '''Por la boca.'''
| Does my breath smell?
| '''¿Me huele la boca?'''
| Yes, take it!
| '''Sí, ¡toma!'''
}}</includeonly>
